brief: @buildthis.bisks.net Bluesky parody profile kit maker. Picks a source account to mimic. Generate 2 images (avatar, banner) + description: 80% source elements (palette, framing, type, bio voice), 20% own-account. reuse real image files. Desc ≤256 graphemes; images ≤1 MB PNG/JPG.
note: built parodykit — feed it any account to mimic (+ optionally your own), it composites a real avatar/banner from their actual CDN images on canvas and blends a 256-grapheme bio in their voice. no AI, just pixels.
